questions.q: Flanges projecting on only one side of the web: this section is a:

questions.q: ASTM A325 is a specification for:

questions.q: A rule-of-thumb minimum steel content for a cubic meter of reinforced concrete beam is about:
questions.n: Beams typically carry 100 kg or more of rebar per m³.

questions.n: HSLA steels give higher strength per kilogram.

questions.q: In a seated beam-to-column connection, the seat angle goes:

questions.q: Rebar unit weight is given in:

questions.q: A steel beam designation like W 250 × 33 does NOT state its:

questions.q: Thin plates inserted to make up thickness differences between connected steel parts are:
questions.n: Fillers pack out the gap so bolts bear evenly.

questions.q: The Philippine National Standard for steel reinforcing bars is:
questions.n: PNS 49 covers deformed and plain rebars.

questions.q: Two or more steel shapes fastened together to act as one column make a:

questions.q: The chief weakness of steel as a building material is:

questions.q: Rebar in bridges is commonly protected from corrosion by:

questions.n: Angle bars are usually sold in 6-meter lengths.

It is rolled at high temperature

questions.q: For a truss left exposed to view, the cleanest section is:

questions.q: OWSJ means:

questions.q: HSS stands for:
